Evan (Finance): quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need owners and hard dates for remediation of the delayed-usage / token-overcount incident. three lanes: engineering fix, invoice corrections, customer comms.

Marta (Eng): i'll take engineering. initial suspect is out-of-order ingestion causing duplicate attribution during the replay window. i'll create a repro, a short dedupe patch at ingestion, and a CI regression that simulates delayed batches. target: repro + patch by 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC.

Diego (Billing): i'll handle invoice corrections. need a CSV of affected request_ids (with customer_id + invoice_id if possible). plan: map -> draft credits -> run two controlled correction batches next week. aim to complete by 2026-03-26.

Rina (Support): Support will prepare outbound notifications and a triage playbook. request list of enterprise customers affected so we can do targeted outreach.

Evan (Finance): Marta please paste a quick query or script that pulls suspect requests so billing can start mapping.

Marta (Eng): quick query (noisy):

```
SELECT req_id, customer_id, reported_tokens, inferred_tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE event_day = '2026-03-19' AND reported_tokens - inferred_tokens > 25
ORDER BY reported_tokens - inferred_tokens DESC
LIMIT 800;
```

Marta (Eng): i'll upload CSV to s3://incidents/token-overcount/2333333333/affected.csv when done.

BillingBot: file_upload: s3://incidents/token-overcount/2333333333/affected.csv uploaded by @marta-eng at 2026-03-20T09:10:12Z; rows=256; size=54KB

Diego (Billing): received. quick policy Q: for already-closed invoices do we issue refunds or account credits? Evan can you confirm?

Evan (Finance): policy: refunds if customer requests and amount > $300; otherwise issue account credits. Enterprise customers get line-item adjustments. Documented.

Rina (Support): drafting two templates (credit notice + refund flow). will share by 2026-03-21 12:00 UTC.

Marta (Eng): deployed a canary dedupe at ingestion to staging. initial replay shows duplicate attributions reduced by ~92%. i'll add a metric "ingest_dedupe_rate" and an alert if >0.3% for a daily window.

Diego (Billing): mapping complete: ~62 invoices affected, 14 > $1k. estimated total adjustment ~$12,300. posting owner+ETA doc to remediate tracker.

Evan (Finance): action items summary:
- Marta (Eng): repro, dedupe patch, CI regression, PD alert (due 2026-03-20 EOD)
- Diego (Billing): invoice mapping, credit memos, batch corrections (start 2026-03-22)
- Rina (Support): templates + triage playbook (due 2026-03-21 12:00)

Marta (Eng): note: i'll also add an integration test that replays out-of-order events weekly to catch regressions.

BillingBot: remediation_tracker updated by @evan-finance at 2026-03-20T10:05:00Z; link=https://internal/redwood/remediation/2333333333

Diego (Billing): starting first correction batch on 2026-03-22 09:00 PST. support please standby for customer replies.

Rina (Support): acknowledged. will monitor tickets and escalate. will log any customer refund requests to Evan.

Evan (Finance): thanks all. i'll close the loop in the tracker when batches finish. update this thread when tasks complete. :thumbsup:
